name.es: Operaciones Git reales de principio a fin, incluido un conflicto de fusion real
name.en: Real end-to-end Git operations, including a real merge conflict

pre.es: Directorio de trabajo temporal real con un proyecto HYDRA real ya creado; ningun colaborador simulado.
pre.en: Real temporary working directory with a real HYDRA project already created; no simulated collaborators.

setup.es: RemoteGitWorkspaceService real con NativeGitRunner real (ejecuta el binario git real sin shell), GitRemoteUrlResolver real, ConfiguredRemoteStorageCredentialResolver real (constructor de pruebas sin autenticacion) y un perfil GitHub real (owner/repositorio publicos conocidos) registrado en RemoteStorageProperties real.
setup.en: Real RemoteGitWorkspaceService with a real NativeGitRunner (runs the real git binary without a shell), a real GitRemoteUrlResolver, a real ConfiguredRemoteStorageCredentialResolver (its test constructor, no authentication) and a real GitHub profile (well-known public owner/repository) registered in a real RemoteStorageProperties.

executes.es: service.execute/.repositoryTree/.conflictView/.resolveConflict reales: INIT, COMMIT_ALL, CREATE_BRANCH, CHECKOUT, STATUS, arbol de ramas, un MERGE real entre dos ramas que cambian la misma linea (conflicto real), vista real del fichero y resolucion real guardada y preparada, y un commit real que completa la fusion.
executes.en: Real service.execute/.repositoryTree/.conflictView/.resolveConflict: INIT, COMMIT_ALL, CREATE_BRANCH, CHECKOUT, STATUS, a branch tree query, a real MERGE between two branches changing the same line (a real conflict), a real view of the file and a saved, staged real resolution, then a real commit completing the merge.

asserts.es: El repositorio queda limpio tras cada paso; el arbol de ramas refleja la rama actual; un merge real produce un conflicto real con el fichero listado; la vista muestra el contenido local y remoto reales; la resolucion queda guardada y preparada sin conflictos restantes; el commit final deja el repositorio limpio con el contenido resuelto.
asserts.en: The repository is clean after each step; the branch tree reflects the current branch; a real merge produces a real conflict with the file listed; the view shows the real local and remote content; the resolution is saved and staged with no remaining conflicts; the final commit leaves the repository clean with the resolved content.

behavior.es: Operar con Git ejecuta de verdad el binario git para cada operacion elegida, incluida una fusion real que puede dejar un conflicto real; el conflicto se ve y se resuelve escribiendo de verdad el contenido resuelto en el repositorio real antes de completarlo con un commit real.
behavior.en: Operating with Git genuinely runs the real git binary for each chosen operation, including a real merge that can leave a real conflict; the conflict is viewed and resolved by genuinely writing the resolved content into the real repository before completing it with a real commit.

rule.es: Cada operacion local, incluida la fusion, se ejecuta como un comando git real sin shell; un conflicto real nunca se resuelve en silencio, requiere escribir y preparar de verdad el contenido resuelto.
rule.en: Each local operation, including the merge, runs as a real, shell-free git command; a real conflict is never silently resolved, it requires genuinely writing and staging the resolved content.

scenario.es: Proyecto HYDRA real; init, commit, crear rama, checkout, status; arbol real de ramas; dos ramas reales que cambian la misma linea de un fichero real, fusion real con conflicto real, vista y resolucion reales del conflicto, commit real que completa la fusion.
scenario.en: Real HYDRA project; init, commit, branch creation, checkout, status; a real branch tree; two real branches changing the same line of a real file, a real merge with a real conflict, a real view and resolution of the conflict, a real commit completing the merge.

result.es: Repositorio real correcto en cada paso, incluido un conflicto real detectado, visto, resuelto y completado de verdad.
result.en: Correct real repository at every step, including a real conflict genuinely detected, viewed, resolved and completed.

expected.es: Las aserciones sobre el estado devuelto y el contenido real del repositorio, incluido el conflicto real, coinciden con lo esperado en cada paso.
expected.en: Assertions on the returned state and the repository's real content, including the real conflict, match expectations at every step.

guarantee.es: Evidencia real de que las operaciones Git locales de HYDRA, incluida la fusion con conflicto real, ejecutan de verdad git sobre un repositorio real, sin simular ningun resultado.
guarantee.en: Real evidence that HYDRA's local Git operations, including a real merge conflict, genuinely run git against a real repository, without simulating any outcome.

limits.es: No cubre fetch, pull ni push contra un remoto real, que necesitan credenciales y acceso de red reales y quedan fuera de esta prueba a proposito.
limits.en: Does not cover fetch, pull or push against a real remote, which need real credentials and network access and are deliberately out of scope for this test.

strengthWhy.es: Integracion real de extremo a extremo (traits.mocks=false): ejecuta el binario git real a traves de la cadena de produccion real, incluido un conflicto de fusion real producido, visto y resuelto de verdad, sin mocks, con un repositorio real verificable en disco en cada paso, cubriendo directamente repos_author_git a/b/c/d/f/r.
strengthWhy.en: Real end-to-end integration (traits.mocks=false): runs the real git binary through the real production chain, including a real merge conflict genuinely produced, viewed and resolved, with no mocks, with a real, independently verifiable on-disk repository at every step, directly covering repos_author_git a/b/c/d/f/r.

scenario.es: init, commit, rama, checkout, status reales
scenario.en: Real init, commit, branch, checkout, status

result.es: Repositorio real correcto en cada paso
result.en: Correct real repository at every step

scenario.es: Dos ramas reales cambian la misma linea; fusion real con conflicto real
scenario.en: Two real branches change the same line; a real merge with a real conflict

result.es: Conflicto real visto, resuelto y completado; repositorio real limpio
result.en: Real conflict viewed, resolved and completed; clean real repository
